## Activity

Market Eye Clinic completed routine imaging activity during October 2022. A total of 419 captures were recorded during the reporting month. Session lists ran as planned, apart from routine leave. No disruption to scheduled activity was identified in the information reviewed. The recorded volume provides the basis for assessing image quality and subsequent grading outcomes for the site.

## Image quality

Of the 419 captures, 23 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.5 per cent. The ungradable images could not be used for grading and should remain a focus for routine quality assurance. Staff should continue to review image acquisition practice and address any recurring issues through normal local processes.

## Grading

There were 97 referable results during October 2022. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. This indicates that grading activity was completed within a short interval for the reporting period. The site should continue to monitor grading timeliness alongside the number of referable outcomes and the proportion of images that are ungradable.
